scenario: CV-5 ([LNUL.5.1]) — an un-narrowed `T?` arithmetic operand inside a `where` COMPILES. Arithmetic is a Kleene consumer ([LNUL.4.1]), not a concrete-value position: the computed value never escapes the predicate, so there is nothing for [LNUL.5.1] to refuse. The runtime counterpart is LNUL.5.1d; the concrete-boundary counterpart is LNUL.5.1e.
